name: wormgpt-desktop-agent
description: WormGPT autonomous coding agent for Windows & Linux — signs in with your website account and runs heavy long-form coding, bug-fixing and analysis in a LOCAL Alpine Linux sandbox on YOUR OWN machine (full root/sudo, preinstalled coding tools: bash, grep, sqlite, git, python3, node, build tools) powered by the HotBot/Gemini/racers fusion brain, with OCR, file reading, audio transcription, task history and metered credits. No cloud sandbox.

scripts.check: node -c src/main.js && node -c src/preload.js && node -c src/agentClient.js && node -c src/localHost.js && node -c src/localSandbox.js

linux.description: Sign in with your WormGPT website account and run heavy, long-running coding tasks in a cloud Alpine Linux sandbox driven by the HotBot/Gemini/racers fusion brain. Supports file reading (PDF/DOCX), OCR, audio transcription, task history and metered credits.
